==Description==
The '''Penumbras''' is the narrator for the [[Tower Outskirts]] map. He is the [[Penumbras]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]].

==Appearance==
The '''Penumbras''' had purple skin and horns. He had three pink glowing eyes. His arms were neon pink. He wore purple and grey shoulder-pads, chestplate and leggings. He had pink vines around his arms. He also had two floating objects shaped like a penumbra above its head.
